description: Pure-Dart Espressif Unified Provisioning for Flutter: provision ESP32 devices over Bluetooth LE with Security 0, 1 and 2, Wi-Fi, Thread and custom endpoints.
rules: Run Flutter and Dart through FVM (fvm flutter, fvm dart); the project pins Flutter 3.47.5 and Dart 3.13.
The firmware decides the security scheme through proto-ver; pass only credentials (ProvCredentials.pop or ProvCredentials.security2), never choose a scheme in the app.

Wi-Fi provisioning outcomes are WifiProvisionState values (WifiConnected, WifiFailed, ...); a wrong passphrase or unknown SSID arrives as WifiFailed, while protocol faults are ProvException subclasses.
After WifiConnected the device stops provisioning and disconnects on its own; do not treat that disconnect as an error.
The package never requests BLE permissions; the app must request them before scanning.
esp_prov_core is pure Dart with no Flutter imports; use esp_prov for Flutter apps.
